title: High-protein-friendly Heavy Steamed Malaysian Lettuce Wrap
description: Savor the fluffiness of pillowy steamed Malaysian-style rice cakes wrapped around baby lettuce leaves in a savory broth, all made possible in a tandoor clay pot.

ingredients.name: Baby lettuce leaves
ingredients.notes: Choose fresh baby lettuce for crunch and flavor.

ingredients.name: Salted egg mix (or plain egg yolk)
ingredients.notes: Add protein and creaminess to the dish.

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Dilute for a thick, savory sauce.

ingredients.name: Peanut oil
ingredients.notes: Add a rich and nutty flavor.

ingredients.name: Ginger paste
ingredients.notes: Ginger is a staple in Malaysian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Galangal paste
ingredients.notes: Similar to ginger but with a deeper flavor.

instructions: Combine coconut milk, ginger paste, galangal paste, lime juice, salt, and black pepper in a bowl. Whisk until smooth and set aside.
Heat peanut oil in a tandoor clay pot over medium heat.
Add steamed chicken breast and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add Malaysian rice cakes and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Add the coconut milk mixture and bring to a simmer.
Add fish sauce to taste and stir to combine.
Add salted egg mix and stir until well combined.
Arrange baby lettuce leaves in a serving area.
Spoon the steamed chicken and Malaysian rice cake mixture onto the leaves, wrapping each leaf to create a lettuce wrap.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving for the flavors to meld together.
Prepare the ingredients ahead of time to make the wrapping process smoother.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
